shared_elements: carved/incised marks on a stone surface
justification: A depicts a figural narrative scene — a chariot drawn by horses with helmeted, bearded figures aboard, above a band of stylised mountain scales — while B shows only rows of small incised script-like signs on a rock face with no figures, animals or objects at all. The only correspondence is the generic presence of shallow incised marks arranged in horizontal registers on stone, which is far too unspecific to indicate a shared iconographic scheme.
